description: DELETE, without force, elements whose consumers the platform maintains on its own (tested coverage, phase 2): the IArgument with which the SQL node passes the parameter it declares itself (it leaves together with the ISQLInputParameter), the OnBeforeRequestCallback property of the REST client (the plugin clears it when the callback leaves) and the IDecisionOutcomeNode of each connector of a process Decision (the platform regenerates the internal flow of the decision). Before, the three refused the delete. The Decision is left with two connectors (one End for each) and loses one, and the End of that branch leaves next: the flow of the decision goes back to Start -> Outcome and Verify does not change. Deleting the ONLY connector leaves, as in the Studio, the decision with no exit (Verify error, not a kernel refusal).

ops._why: count 1, real 0: the IArgument of the SQL node itself, derived true
without force: the argument leaves with the parameter
count 1, real 0: CustomProperty OnBeforeRequestCallback of the client itself, derived true
count 1, real 0: the IDecisionOutcomeNode generated for the connector, derived true
without force: the platform rebuilds the decision flow with only Approved
the End of the branch that left was left without an incoming connector
